newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's car industry says to strengthen China ties.
newsitem.headline: Japan's car industry says to strengthen China ties.

text.p: The Japanese car industry said on Thursday it would continue to boost exchanges with its Chinese counterpart.

In a statement expressing regret at the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, a trade body representing Japanese car manufacturers said the industry would continue to pursue a closer relationship with the Chinese auto industry.

"The Japanese auto industry has been cooperating with the Chinese car industry in various ways and we will try to further strengthen these exchanges and contribute to the development of China's auto industry," Yoshifumi Tsuji, chairman of the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association (JAMA), said in the statement.
Deng died in Beijing on Wednesday.
